text.text: Two concurrent P0 incidents are actively blocking revenue: **payment-service** is in a CrashLoopBackOff cycle after 3+ OOMKill terminations against its 512Mi memory limit, and **order-service** has a fully exhausted PostgreSQL connection pool (20/20 active, 47 queued) that has cascaded to the **api-gateway** opening its circuit breaker and returning HTTP 500s to end users. A separate P2 affecting **notification-service** involves an ImagePullBackOff on image `registry.prod.internal/notification-service:v1.2.3`, leaving that deployment stuck in Pending with no rollout possible. Combined, payment processing and order creation are effectively unavailable in production, constituting a full revenue-path outage. **Immediate next step**: patch the payment-service memory limit to 1024Mi via `kubectl set resources deployment/payment-service --limits=memory=1024Mi` to break the CrashLoopBackOff, then in parallel increase the order-service `DB_POOL_MAX` to 50 and reset the api-gateway circuit breaker.

*Issues Identified:*
• *OOM_KILL* on `payment-service, kubelet` — P0 (confidence: 99%)
• *DB_TIMEOUT* on `order-service, api-gateway` — P0 (confidence: 98%)
• *DEPLOY_FAILURE* on `notification-service, kubelet` — P2 (confidence: 97%)
